decisions.reason: This camera remains a strong fit with the firm's established space optics portfolio and, after staying on the market through 2024, looks likely to continue serving stable mission demand.
The modular navigation camera line is deeply aligned with the firm's core business and its multiple models make it strategically useful across different spacecraft programs.

The space situational awareness sensor suite matches growing market needs and the firm's sensor capabilities, even if it is still somewhat less proven commercially than the most established camera products.
The radiation-hard space camera line is very close to the firm's core competence and should be retained because radiation tolerance is a credible value point for many demanding space missions.

The asteroid navigation and imaging camera is technologically plausible for the firm and strategically interesting, but its narrower niche and lighter website presence make it more at risk than the main product lines.
